info.title: UrbanPulse API
info.description: API documentation for the FIICode UrbanPulse backend.

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns a session token.
Authenticates a user and returns a session token.

get.description: Verifies a user's email using the token sent to them.

post.description: Sends a new verification link to the authenticated user's email.
Sends a password reset link to the provided email if an account exists.

200.description: Reset link sent if account exists

post.description: Sends a password change link to the authenticated user's email.
Updates the password using a valid reset/change token.

patch.description: Updates the existing user, identified with the session token, with the provided parameters.

200.description: Profile successfully updated or nothing to update

get.description: Returns the profile of the authenticated user.

bio.example: I can help with emergency supplies.

delete.description: Deletes the currently authenticated user account.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled user account deletion.
Updates the user's email address. Requires verification of the new email.

400.description: Invalid body or current email provided

post.description: Uploads a new profile picture (JPEG, PNG, WEBP).

delete.description: Removes the current user's profile picture.

get.description: Returns the binary content of the user's profile picture.
Returns a list of user IDs blocked by the authenticated user.

post.description: Blocks another user. Blocked users cannot message each other.

400.description: Cannot block yourself or invalid ID

get.description: Returns high-level statistics for the admin dashboard.
Advanced user search for administrators.

patch.description: Changes a user's role (admin, mod, user, banned). Admins can promote anyone, mods can only manage regular users.

delete.description: Schedules a user's account for deletion.

get.description: Returns users whose accounts are scheduled for deletion.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled user account deletion.

get.description: Returns a list of all pulses in the system with admin-only details.
Returns interactions for a specific pulse with helper details.

post.description: Manually marks a pulse interaction as successful.

409.description: Pulse already solved or invalid type

post.description: Manually marks a pulse as solved.

get.description: Returns a simple list of pulses.

delete.description: Deletes a pulse using a query parameter ID.

get.description: Returns detailed pulse info.

delete.description: Deletes a pulse using a path parameter ID.

get.description: Returns all library items for administrative management.
Returns all user-submitted reports.
Returns message reports with joined message content and reporter/offender details. Defaults to pending status.

post.description: Resolves a message report by banning the user, deleting the message, or dismissing the report.

patch.description: Updates a report's status (pending, reviewing, resolved, dismissed).
Updates the user's password, identified with the session token, with the provided parameters.

get.description: Returns the most recent pulses for the live feed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of pulses to return (default 50).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Radius in meters for location-based filtering.

post.description: Creates a new pulse (offer or need) in the live feed.

delete.description: Deletes a pulse. Only available to the author or moderators.

get.description: Returns a list of available resources/skills that can be matched.

post.description: Finds potential helpers based on requested resources and location.

get.description: Returns pulses created by the authenticated user.

get.summary: List pulses you accepted to help with
get.description: Returns pulses where the authenticated user has offered help.

patch.description: Updates pulse content, emergency status, or required skills. Only available to the author or moderators.

post.description: Creates an interaction indicating the user wants to help with this pulse.

409.description: Pulse already solved or already accepted

get.description: Returns all help offers/interactions for a specific pulse. Only available to the author.

post.description: Provides positive feedback for a help interaction, increasing the helper's trust score.
Confirms that an interaction was successful. Usually done by the pulse author.
Marks the pulse as solved. Requires at least one successful interaction.
Upvotes/confirms a pulse report to increase its reliability.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's chat threads with participant metadata.

post.description: Creates either a direct chat or a group chat. The authenticated user is always added as a participant.

400.description: Invalid body or invalid participant combination

404.description: One or more participants do not exist

409.description: A direct chat between these users already exists

get.description: Returns chat participants and metadata for a thread if the user is a participant.
Returns all messages from a chat thread if the requester is a participant.

post.description: Creates a new message in a chat thread.

content.example: Can you help me transport supplies?

delete.description: Deletes a message if the requester is the sender, moderator, or admin.

patch.description: Updates the name of a group chat. Only available to group owners/admins.

post.description: Adds one or more participants to a group chat. Only available to group owners/admins.

delete.description: Removes a participant or leaves the group chat.

post.description: Promotes a participant to admin status in a group chat.

get.description: Returns library items (skills/resources) available in your area.

post.description: Adds a new skill or resource to the global library.

get.description: Returns library items created by the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates a library item's details. Only available to the author.

delete.description: Deletes a library item. Only available to the author.

post.description: Reports a user, message, or pulse for administrative review.

patch.description: Updates the content of a previously sent message.

post.description: Submits a report for a specific message.

400.description: Invalid request or reporting own message

get.description: Searches users with optional filters. Parameters that accept multiple values can be repeated.

parameters.name: anyskillres
parameters.description: Set to true to match any listed skill/resource, false to require all.

parameters.name: skillres
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each skill/resource.

parameters.name: available_days
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each day (0=Sunday ... 6=Saturday).

parameters.name: available_hours
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each timerange CSV string (format HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM]).

delete.description: Deletes users that match the provided optional filters. This endpoint is restricted to admin users.

parameters.name: anyskillres
parameters.description: Set to true to match any listed skill/resource, false to require all.

parameters.name: skillres
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each skill/resource.

parameters.name: available_days
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each day (0=Sunday ... 6=Saturday).

parameters.name: available_hours
parameters.description: Repeat this parameter for each timerange CSV string (format HH:MM-HH:MM[,HH:MM-HH:MM]).
